Voice enhancement (noise reduction and Podcast mode) runs on-device and the user's voice is not uploaded anywhere to be cleaned up

Screen Studio records the screen without the mouse cursor, then adds the cursor back into the final video afterward, using precise synchronized mouse movement data, which lets it apply cursor effects after recording that other screen recorders can't.
Screen Studio's Yearly plan costs $9/mo, billed as a save-69% annual plan, and includes all Screen Studio features.
Screen Studio's Monthly plan costs $29/mo and includes all Screen Studio features.
Every Screen Studio plan includes export up to 4K at 60 fps.
Screen Studio currently supports only macOS; there are no near-future plans to add a Windows version.
Screen Studio never sends recording data to servers; recordings are stored and processed locally on the user's computer.
Screen Studio requires macOS 13.1 or later (recommended) to run.
Customer Stephan Meijer said it took him about 5 minutes to create a nice-looking video with Screen Studio to demo a new theme editor for the @magicbell_io push-subscription dialog.
